title: Owner: battery and fleet views as a bricks pattern or a shared domain package
goal: The owner chooses where the battery and fleet views live
acceptance: The decision is recorded in F-008 and given to the coordinator; any follow-up work is a new record in the repository that owns it
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Closed 2026-11-25: Owner decision 2026-11-25: each project owns its own screens, built with 🧱 bricks; NERV keeps no copies and shows FPVBuddy's data as genUI surface cards in chat (MCP tools return surface-typed data, rendered by the matching bricks surface in NERV's theme) and as full screens through an MCP Apps page or a link to FPVBuddy's own page. The battery and fleet views live in FPVBuddy; NERV's FPV pack views retire once the core moves (nerv:F-101-T04). Coordinator rule: coordinator PR #50. FPVBuddy follow-up: F-009.
